text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
"...Hello. Do you know why Winning Lives 
were started in the first place?"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"It's because an Umamusume who wins a race 
wants to express her gratitude to the fans 
who cheered for her, right?"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
That's right. To show off my finest 
appearance and convey my gratitude to the 
fans who supported me.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
Still, it seems the true beginning was a 
little different.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
They say a certain Umamusume said she 
wanted to sing. And that's supposedly how 
the Grand Live came to be.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...You want to sing? Why is that?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, it's because they're able to 
connect.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...To stay connected.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Is that why this song was sung at the 
first Grand Live...?

At Light Hello's request, the Umamusume 
worked on writing lyrics for the song. 
They—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...*deflates*

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Heat detected. Execute command: 'Dump 
water over head'?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine! I was just thinking how tough 
writing lyrics really is.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I knew it was the culmination of 
technique, but once I actually started 
thinking about it, there's just so much to 
keep in mind...
choice_data_list: You don't need to overthink it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh...
choice_data_list:
Maybe try putting the feelings you want to 
convey into words

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Our present.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The feelings I want to convey...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I want to tell them, 'I'm home.' And 
'Thank you for waiting for me.'

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...I want you to look at me. Look at me! 
Follow me! I want to tell you to cheer 
only for me!

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! I want to tell them it's not over 
yet! No matter how far behind you are, 
there's a goal you can't give up on!"

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
I want to tell them that until then, no 
matter what happens, I want them to keep 
running alongside me...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I... want to show everyone. That I can 
still run even now.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To everyone who expects me to dash through 
to the finish line. Thank you for letting 
me run.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
For me, maybe it's the power to break 
through.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Tachyon-chan!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Just how much of an impact concerts have 
on an Umamusume... Unfortunately, that 
scope remains an unknown. In that case, I 
might as well hold some extra 
expectations!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Then, in addition to "I'm home,"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I want to tell them... that it's because 
you were there that I was able to run 
here.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's quite lively here. How are you 
feeling?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness. Trainer, I actually had 
something to discuss regarding the setlist 
for the live show—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then I want lyrics meant for 
call-and-response!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It might be a little different from just 
expressing our feelings, but I want it to 
be a song where we call out to each 
other...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Call & Response"... Call and response. 
It's a format where both sides shout out 
cues to each other.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, a fan mentioned that 
before. They said it makes them so happy 
when we can all call out together at 
concerts."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Right? Exactly! Because...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume and fans can't run together, 
but through singing, we can raise our 
voices as one!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I believe the best course of action is to 
check that proposal with the other girls 
right away."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, let's go listen! There are new 
girls joining in too!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
'Uma Musume and fans can't run together, 
but with a song, they can raise their 
voices together.'

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. So that's why the Umamusume who 
created the first Grand Live chose 
singing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Of course, it's so we can "connect" 
through song.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us also put on the final touches! 
I hear more people have expressed wanting 
to participate again, after all!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"To make this the absolute best live, I 
look forward to working with you until the 
very end!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, on the way back from discussing 
the "feelings they wanted to convey"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, a certain phrase crossed my 
mind. It was—
choice_data_list:
A "song where we call out to each other", 
huh...
"Gratitude for being able to run," huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—<chrname>, too, will surely pour her heart into 
her singing at the Grand Live.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking up at the sky, the stars were 
twinkling. I can't wait for the day of the 
Grand Live.
